local u11 = false
local inputPosition
local FramePosition
Frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    local v15 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1

    if not v15 then
        v15 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end

    if v15 then
        u11 = true
        inputPosition = input.Position
        FramePosition = Frame.Position
    end
end)
Frame.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    local v17 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1

    if not v17 then
        v17 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end

    if v17 then
        u11 = false
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    local v19 = u11

    if v19 then
        v19 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement

        if not v19 then
            v19 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        end
    end

    if v19 then
        local v20 = input.Position - inputPosition

        Frame.Position = UDim2.new(FramePosition.X.Scale, FramePosition.X.Offset + v20.X, FramePosition.Y.Scale, FramePosition.Y.Offset + v20.Y)
    end
end)
